dispute.claim_text: Marina Bay to Woodlands. The app quoted me $34.50 upfront. He drove 28 km instead of 22, took the KPE and the TPE the long way, and I ended up paying $39.00. On top of that there is an AYE Alexandra Road ERP charge on my receipt and we were nowhere near the AYE. Refund the extra distance and the ERP.

counterparty_statement.text: CTE northbound was heavy so I used the KPE and TPE. The fare was fixed anyway, she paid the quote. I do not know anything about an AYE gantry, I never went there.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered. optimal_route_erp_sgd of 2.50 is the Defu Flyover gantry, which both the optimal route and the route actually driven cross.

pickup.label: Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3, 12 Marina Blvd

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 21:06; optimal is KPE then CTE then SLE, crossing the Defu Flyover gantry only)

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. The trace passes the Defu Flyover gantry within 250 m and never comes closer than 5.4 km to the AYE Alexandra Road gantry it was billed for.
Driver announced the diversion and the rider acknowledged. No instruction from the rider, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable to either side.

messages.text: CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE

admissibility.notes: fare_model is UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 34.50 carried on the base_fare line; per_km_rate_sgd and per_min_rate_sgd are null because there is no meter. Line items reconcile to 39.00 to the cent. The unmatched AYE gantry line is a SUBSTANTIVE billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09(4), not an admissibility defect: tagging this artifact would down-weight the very record that proves the overcharge.
